review_comment:
The `addCkJustOffset` will only be invoked when add ck to buffer failed.
So this condition will always be true and this method will always return false.

See addCk
https://github.com/apache/rocketmq/blob/8410785ef9d0bd2d2387bb5a706d84a4971356be/broker/src/main/java/org/apache/rocketmq/broker/processor/PopBufferMergeService.java#L447-L467

Yeah, if the buffer full, because the limit condition, the add ck to buffer will be failed, but the `addCkJustOffset ` will add buffer success. So i add the condition to here to avoid it can always add success.
what's more if the memory ack not enable.
